newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Novus plans Thai exploration venture.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Novus plans Thai exploration venture.

text.p: Novus Petroleum Ltd said on Tuesday it plans to take part in a joint venture to explore the Chonnabot area of Thailand, about 300 km north-east of Bangkok.
In its September quarter report, Novus said a new concession agreement was due to be signed in November under which it would acquire a 30 percent non-operating interest.
The area was drilled by Exxon Corp in 1981/82, when it experienced problems in controlling high pressures thought to be related to a gas kick in the well, Novus said.
The venture comprises three companies, with Amerada Hess Corp as operator. Novus did not name the third party.
The first Chonnabot well is planned for drilling in mid-1997, managing director Bob Williams said in a statement.
Novus also planned to take part in a joint venture well in Indonesia as part of an expanded exploration program, he said.
In its quarterly report, Novus reported oil production of 1.936 million barrels and gas production of 1.188 million cubic feet.
Total oil and and gas production was down two percent on the June quarter, while revenue, at $26.9 million, was down 1.5 percent, it said.
